name: shotcraft studio
description: House brand for the shotcraft studio. Layered over the upstream Remotion template without editing it.

fonts.sans: 'Inter Tight', 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.cjk: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', sans-serif

motion.note: Motion parameters are NOT a brand concern. They live in the shot-card corpus and are compiled into a brief per shot. A kit that tried to set them here would fork the corpus.
